decision_sequence.meaning: This formalizes the workflow-byte admission already communicated before publication. It records no diagnostic execution or product qualification.

findings.finding: The original Windows job compiled the helper-corrected fixture and completed 66 of 68 CTests. Both failures rejected copied-state protocol records before numerical evaluation. The retained logs identify the compound predicates but contain no actual native frame header from which to prove a mismatching leaf. Exact case0/case46 header acquisition addresses that concrete gap.

The workflow runs only on the dedicated investigation branch, has a distinct concurrency group with cancellation disabled, and explicitly checks out the immutable failed source. It records the checked-out source commit separately from GITHUB_SHA, the workflow-definition commit. The three existing product workflows restrict push events to main, so this branch push does not request their matrices.

Provenance checks HEAD against 6287055, requires no tracked diff and hashes tracked code/build/tool/data/workflow inputs before work. The unchanged repository acquisition tools verify locked SDL2 and RtMidi. Post-failure verification repeats both dependency checks and every recorded source hash, rechecks HEAD and the tracked diff. Source, test, oracle, CMake and production edits are absent from the reviewed workflow.

The Windows configure argument list matches the original Windows job: Visual Studio 17 2022, x64, BUILD_TESTING ON, standalone ON, VST3 OFF, original Python path, pinned SDL2/RtMidi roots, MIDI ON and original install directories. Only the two existing fixture targets and their dependencies are built, in Release with parallelism two. Compiler identity files, CMake cache/configure log, verbose build output and required Windows/WASAPI/dummy SDL backend macros are retained. Actual runner/toolchain versions remain observations to compare, not assumed identical binaries.

CTest discovery requires exactly the two named tests, existing executable paths, original Python scripts/-B, no disabled tests, both TIMEOUT 90 properties and header's --timeout-seconds 20. The filtered CTest run retains the original Release, verbose, serial, no-tests=error and fallback-180 invocation. CMake's explicit 90-second properties remain controlling. There is one invocation, no repeat option and no oracle/deadline relaxation.

The original-test step temporarily disables immediate shell exit only to preserve PIPESTATUS[0] in original-ctest-exit.txt, then exits with that exact CTest result. It is not marked continue-on-error. A reproduced failure therefore remains a failed step/job while later always-conditional acquisition and upload retain evidence.

Exactly two supplemental children are requested: footage --case 0 and header --case 46. The collector uses the unchanged readers' 20-second child deadline, five-second cleanup bounds, 64 KiB read chunks and original stdout/stderr caps. Both pipes are drained concurrently through the full bounded stream; capture does not close stdout at the first newline and thereby induce a broken pipe.

Each exact first line, including its newline when present, is persisted as -header.bin before JSON parsing or semantic validation; bounded stderr is persisted separately. Missing-newline captures retain a capped prefix and an explicit incomplete result. Receipts include return code, timeout/capture errors, lengths and SHA-256 values, executable size/hash, reader source hash, full-stream hash and RGBA-tail size/hash. No images are persisted.

Additional parsed JSON and strict typed differences are derived from the unchanged reader's expected controls/session functions. Both original parse_frame functions are invoked unchanged and their success/error recorded. Those comparisons neither modify nor substitute the original predicates. Difference lists are bounded to 100 entries and are supplemental; exact raw headers are the authoritative acquired bytes.

A successful capture step means that bounded native output and a header were acquired without process/stderr failures. It deliberately does not mean that the unchanged protocol parser or the numerical test passed. A protocol error is retained in the capture record; original CTest outcomes remain authoritative for the two checks.

Capture runs after successful discovery even if CTest fails; source/dependency rechecks run after successful dependency preparation even if later steps fail; artifact upload always runs and errors if no files exist. The artifact includes diagnostic files, CMake cache/configure log and original CTest logs. Missing preparation, incomplete capture, failed rechecks, cancellation or failed upload must remain unqualified, rather than inferred successful.

This is one explicitly admitted new investigation using the old failed source, not a retry of the product workflow, a repaired source or product acceptance. Any pass is a separate source/runner observation and cannot erase the original Windows failures. The mismatching leaf and cause remain unestablished until the actual header evidence is inspected.

execution_constraints: Root alone authors/publishes/executes the diagnostic workflow and retains the exact workflow/source/run/job/attempt identities.
Admission binds only the reviewed 20,167-byte workflow SHA; a changed workflow needs its affected scope reviewed.
Keep all source/tests/CMake/dependency locks, MSVC warning policy, fixed workload and original CTest/child deadlines unchanged.
Execute each selected original CTest once and each supplemental case once; no repeat-until-pass loop, re-run or extra exploratory case is admitted by this record.

Observe and retain both original test outcomes, exact raw headers, process errors, actual compiler/configuration and executable identities, and successful source/dependency postchecks before using the data.
Download and verify actual diagnostic artifact contents before claiming the missing header or any precise typed leaf has been observed; upload metadata alone is insufficient.
Compare original CTest executable identities with supplemental capture identities before attributing differences to one binary.
Keep raw bytes, derived parsed records and leaf differences distinguishable; a bounded difference list is not asserted exhaustive.
Any subsequent source/oracle correction requires an independent evidence-based admission and qualification at its own source. No correction is authorized here.

Do not reinterpret current Core/VST3 successes, the whole hosted aggregate, native fixtures or this investigation as literal whole-interface 1:1, hardware fidelity, device/accessibility, callback-deadline or signed-release acceptance.
next_action: Root observes the one separately published investigation. Preserve its actual outcomes, retrieve the bounded headers and compare the exact typed leaves. Decide any repair prospectively from that evidence; otherwise keep the two original failed gates open.
